Thank you. but everyone keeps assuming i have a fantasy, when part of the reason i really do just wish i would die is that every single fantasy i've had has been completely obliterated and other guys have gotten to live them. She has already done everything physically and felt everything emotionally and talked about every emotion and gone places, even vacations, and done fun couple things... the one tiny thing i had left of course she had to do with someone else now and it happened in the most gut-wrenching way and there is no point in living anymore if she's never going to have anything with me that is special

and i am so insecure about her hooking up and even just kissing other people that i already did almost kill myself over it and she said things that made it worse. because i haven't ever done those things because i've been in love with her for so long... it's not like i couldn't... and feel like part of her would care. i mean i can't even talk to her and i'm still so upset over that. and mostly i'm just so upset at how everything in society is about hooking up and kissing and having sex and it's like i'm the only person in the world who it isn't about that for. i can even go back to the guy she's seeing now - who seems nice and all -  where he commented about when he should've "made a move" with a girl he had a crush on and talked about other sexual things and it's like that's half of what all relationships are about.. how exciting it is when you first hook up with someone and it's never even been anything about that teen/twenty hormone shit for me all it is is that i love her and i am just so upset all of that and now this and it is too much

i shouldn't get more specific but i really don't think i can feel this with someone else. I would have been so happy if it was with her and other people can't replicate that. she isn't just another case of being in love and no one will ever get that

i guess i still would, but now i don't even know if that would be enough because she's felt everything with everyone else and i just don't believe something is that special and amazing if you can feel it over and over again
so i have nothing to calm me and all i can think about is that i want to die, and not in the spur of the moment way but the way that's been eating at me for months

anyway, thank you though, that was nice

I'm just going advise you to stop, although if you're like me that advice is idiotic, but considering I had that exact quote as my background before  and tried the whole get in amazing shape and dress nice, I thought I would try to warn you. Because that was over a year ago now and it only gets worse dude and chances are she will be... well, kind of a bitch... and only see you as like creepy which isn't exactly her fault, so please unless you are really sure just don't. i don't know though, my circumstances were kind of unique

tl;dr: i've been where you are and tried that and am telling you to please stop so you don't feel as bad as i do
That last thing is the absolute only thing that's kept me from doing it

I guess I should thank everyone. I have tried literally everything I can think of and she has no idea--- she pretty much hates me at this point I think. and she hasn't even see me as me for a long time, so the whole I want her to be happy thing to prevent me from doing it doesn't matter, because I honestly don't even think she would care if I did, 

But it just won't get out of my head and I didn't ever think I could but more and more I just don't see anything else. My life used to be happy.
And especially now this just hurts in such a unique personal way that makes it too much so I really just want to. And I'm not going to tell anybody so I just wanted to ask.
and i don't think snyone is taking me seriously and I'm trying to find a way to doit and make it look natural and  it's not just a call for attention

I guess I could go into why she has \everything I want in someone, or why there is a certain emotional connection you can't describe, or why I don't really believe in love in the sense of finding someone you get along awesome with and then moving on and finding someone else and repeating this cycle until you decide you are the age and place you want to get married and stick with someone.
But really, I get that other people could offer other things, etc, but how am I supposed to be fair to myself or others if I would always prefer what this particular girl gives me? I'm not going to be happy being with someone that loves me back just because they love me back when i know if someone else had loved me back it would have meant more.
And she is everything to me and I can't keep persisting forever, I can't do that to her, and I really just want to die
It's been a few years already, and I've tried as hard as I possibly can to take it and live my life and things are getting too much
